data.name: Carba
data.description: Carba is a Minneapolis, Minnesota carbon removal company whose pyrolysis technology and burial method removes CO2, storing biochar underground in low-oxygen environments using a patented, highly efficient pyrolysis reactor. The company will deliver 44,000 CDR credits to Microsoft over 5 years, and its methodology is certified by carbon removal registry Isometric for 1000+ year durability. Carba also received a $7 million DOE Carbon Negative Shot Pilot grant and is backed by GigaClimate Builder.
